Each section opens with the record's reproduction headline and any usage
warning ([label definitions](../eos-labels.md)), then the scope and basis of
the stored check. Only recorded content is shown: missing selections, weights,
errors or conventions are unknown, not zero, and are not inferred. Generating
this page fits nothing and changes no classification or source coefficient.
Every record is also listed by identifier in the
[numerical ledger](../primary-eos-refits.md#records), its
[machine-readable form](https://github.com/CPrescher/peritheos/blob/main/docs/data/primary-eos-refits.json) and the
[source-audit reports](../source-audits.md).

**Curves and residuals** replay the full stored source and reconstructed
coefficients on the same recorded audit inputs. Residual = model − input in
the fitted quantity's native units; for pressure, P(model) − P(input) at each
input volume and temperature (isothermal records use their reference
temperature). RMS is an unweighted descriptive error, not a parameter
uncertainty or the weighted fitting objective. With more than five
temperatures, the minimum, middle and maximum isotherms are drawn; residuals
include every selected row. Error bars appear only where all widths are
recoverable and keep the source meaning, including digitization widths.
No uncertainty band is inferred.

**Coefficient graphs** show stored central values and recorded error widths
in the audit's units; each panel includes zero. They are not observation or
residual plots. Fixed/adopted values are constraints, not recovered values.
Tables round an error to two significant digits when its leading digit is 1
or 2, otherwise one, and the value to the error's decimal place; values
without a positive error show at most six significant digits. Full precision
stays in EOSMAT and the ledger.

## Peritheos refit of Bykova et al. (2018), calculated BM3

**reproduced** · `coesite_iv_bykova_2018_am05_static_bm3_refit` · `BM3` · [Coefficients and source](../material-summaries/coesite_iv.md#record-coesite_iv_bykova_2018_am05_static_bm3_refit)

**Scope:** Reproduction of a stored independent Peritheos refit. **Basis:** Reproduction of the registered Peritheos refit's stored coefficients under its declared protocol.

- This comparison concerns the stored independent Peritheos refit, not recovery of the original publication's coefficients or author workflow.
- Replays the stored Peritheos one-parameter refit, not a published V0 or the authors' E-P-V regression. K0=168.52 GPa and K0-prime=3.34 are adopted from Supplementary Table 11 and held fixed. Three calculated Table 10 pressures are printed as whole GPa; they are not exact states. The V0 formal standard error is conditional residual-scatter covariance, not a source uncertainty or a rounding/systematic error budget. The unweighted residual sum per degree of freedom is not a statistical reduced chi-square. Figure 6 supplies separate graphical checks, including five points beyond the three apparent table counterparts; none is fitted. See the dedicated coesite-IV audit for reading bounds and limitations.

The source/target values below are the stored **Peritheos refit**. Agreement with it does not reproduce the original publication's coefficients.

### Method

- **Dataset identifiers:** coesite\_iv\_bykova\_2018\_table10\_calc\_pv
- **Observations:** 3
- **Fit kind:** stored\_refit\_reproduction
- **Selection:** all three coesite-IV Table 10 rows; Figure 6 excluded
- **Objective:** pressure\_residuals
- **Weighting:** Equal pressure weights; no source standard deviations supplied.
- **Absolute sigma:** False
- **Free parameters:** V0
- **Fixed parameters:** K0; K0\_prime
- **Fixed values:**
    - **K0:** 168.52
    - **K0 prime:** 3.34

## Bykova et al. (2018), combined coesite-IV/V experimental BM2 at 32.7 GPa

**untested** (source calculation reconstructed) · `coesite_iv_v_bykova_2018_experimental_bm2_reference` · `BM2Reference` · [Coefficients and source](../material-summaries/coesite_iv.md#record-coesite_iv_v_bykova_2018_experimental_bm2_reference)

**Warning:** Not recommended for use. A joint coesite-IV/V fit, not a pure-phase EOS, with large observation residuals and an unresolved fitting protocol.

**Scope:** Reconstruction of a source equation or calculation. **Basis:** Published joint coesite-IV/V room-temperature empirical fit, not a pure-phase EOS. The explicit 32.7 GPa reference-pressure BM2 reproduces Figure 1's red vector curve within its stroke/calibration bounds. All 16 Table 2 observations are retained: pressure RMS 4.04659 GPa; maximum 11.85457 GPa at the 44.5 GPa coesite-V datum. The source acknowledges significant between-run scatter. Original objective, weights, row mask, fixed/free reference-volume choice and covariance are unspecified. The independent equal-weight diagnostic does not recover the source coefficients and is not adopted. Source-equation validation is not author-fit parity or physical validation. See the dedicated experimental audit. Retained for reproduction of the published joint empirical curve. Large observation residuals, unresolved fitting protocol, stress sensitivity and joint-phase scope preclude recommendation for quantitative pure-phase predictions or pressure calibration. Explicit selection only.

- Retained for reproduction of the published joint empirical curve. Large observation residuals, unresolved fitting protocol, stress sensitivity and joint-phase scope preclude recommendation for quantitative pure-phase predictions or pressure calibration. Explicit selection only.
